quote: He rustled his feathers and held his slender neck high, as he cried out with full heart: ‘I never dreamed there could be so much happiness, when I was the ugly duckling.’
source: Hans Christian Andersen, The Ugly Duckling, the closing sentence (the swan) (trans. Jean Hersholt, 1949)
speaker: the ugly duckling, now a swan

evidence.where: The Hans Christian Andersen Centre, University of Southern Denmark, Hersholt translation page
